purpose: Select trifecta finishing seat by prior-year formation hit probability relative to current final trifecta market pricing.

policies.PROB_ONLY: Select seat with highest prior-year formation hit probability.
policies.VALUE_RATIO: Select seat maximizing prior formation hit probability divided by current summed implied probability mass.
policies.MARKET_CHEAPEST: Select seat with lowest current summed implied probability mass.

market_mass_formula: sum(1/final_trifecta_odds) over the seat formation tickets

data.odds: fixed KEIBA-BACKFILL SHA data/odds/daily; comma-safe parsing
